huawei: Review the CloudEngine VLAN object command and its existing-name/state semantics; do not substitute VLANIF shutdown for Layer-2 VLAN state.
juniper: Resolve the numeric VLAN ID to the existing Junos VLAN object and its references; review rename/deactivation semantics separately from Cisco state suspend.

huawei: Implement and validate the VRP access/trunk replacement, LoopBack or routed Eth-Trunk contract for this operation; preserve unrelated interface configuration.
juniper: Implement and validate the ELS membership replacement, lo0 unit or routed ae/LACP contract for this operation; prove logical-unit and aggregate prerequisites.

huawei: Bind a reviewed VRP default/floating-route template, including preference limits and directly connected next-hop/primary-route checks.
juniper: Review the Junos route and qualified-next-hop preference contract for the selected platform.

huawei: Implement the operation-specific VRP process/area/interface or import-route template with confirmed process, area and bounded route-policy facts.
juniper: Define explicit Junos routing-instance scope instead of treating Cisco process IDs as native Junos process IDs; validate interface/area membership and export-policy effects.

huawei: Implement a named advanced IPv4 ACL contract with validated rule identity/order, complete replacement semantics and attachment behavior, including the unmatched-traffic action.
juniper: Define the inet filter/term identity, ordering, unmatched-traffic action and logical attachment unit; do not assume Cisco sequence numbers are native Junos term identities.

huawei: Define the traffic-classifier/behavior/policy and queue mapping explicitly, including rate units, burst limits and supported attachment directions; Cisco MQC bandwidth is not a portable queue contract.
juniper: Define forwarding classes, loss priority, queues, scheduler maps and policer attachment explicitly; a Cisco policy-map is not a Junos scheduler map.

modify_vlan: The current operation changes active/suspend state only. A native equivalent has not been verified for this profile; this is not a claim that the vendor lacks VLAN management.
rename_vlan: Confirm existing VLAN identity, name collisions and references before emitting a rename.
configure_trunk_allowed_vlans: Replacement must remove obsolete members; additive-only syntax does not fulfill this operation.
configure_port_channel: Require clean compatible members, explicit LACP mode and aggregate capacity; do not silently convert routed/switchport modes.
enable_ospf_process: Do not invent a process identifier, router ID or instance, or emit an empty non-persistent configuration hierarchy.
advertise_network: Confirm which addressed interfaces the prefix selects; do not replace interface participation with unrestricted redistribution.
configure_ospf_redistribution: Require a source-specific, bounded default-deny export policy and explicit metric semantics.
create_acl: Review how an empty or description-only object persists and behaves before later attachment.
modify_acl_rule: The existing contract requires a complete replacement rule, not an inferred partial update.
create_qos_policy: The existing contract includes explicit policy terms and bandwidth reservations; creating only an empty vendor policy is not equivalent.
classify_by_dscp: Confirm the exact previous DSCP set and detached classifier before replacement.
configure_scheduler: The existing contract edits a detached policy class's absolute bandwidth; define the equivalent vendor queue/scheduler scope before activation.
configure_shaping: Review egress shaping attachment, whole-interface impact, rate granularity and existing policy collisions.
configure_policing: Review ingress policing, burst units, exceed action and hardware limits; never assume the Cisco values have identical vendor meaning.
